title: Narrating a Data Finding
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting narrating a data finding to Excel pivot-table finding with unit labels, source note, and claim-first chart title, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Compute a percentage change correctly as (new - old) / old and state it without rounding-up inflation
Write a finding-first sentence that leads with the result before the procedure
Match the verb to the magnitude (a 40% gap is 'higher,' not 'skyrocketed') and flag a correlation as a correlation, naming a competing explanation rather than asserting cause
Accept or reject AI rewrites of a data sentence based on whether they inflate magnitude or smuggle in causal verbs, logging each call

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
